description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingModifyCommand' that extends other interfaces to represent commands that modify the state of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It declares methods related to setting headers and checking authorization effects.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommand
classes.description: A generic interface representing commands that modify the state of a 'Thing', with methods to set headers and check if the command impacts authorization.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command, allowing customization of metadata associated with the command.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command modifies the authorization of the 'Thing'.
